name: ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter
fact: ExoMars 2016 mission's surviving half (Schiaparelli was the lander). Characterises atmospheric methane, water vapour, and other trace gases at part-per-trillion sensitivity. Found no methane above 0.05 ppbv — far below all prior claimed detections — deepening rather than settling the methane mystery. Curiosity's surface-level detections remain unexplained.
capability: Highest-sensitivity atmospheric trace-gas mapping at any planet.
